intro: The Maldives has around half a million people, about a third of them in the crowded capital, Malé.

chapters.title: People
text: Maldivians speak Dhivehi, written in a script called Thaana that runs right to left. All citizens must be Muslim.
Many foreign workers, especially from Bangladesh and India, work in building and tourism.

chapters.title: Malé
text: Malé is one of the most densely populated cities in the world, packed onto one small island.
